image_description: An underwater scene featuring two scuba divers swimming near a sandy seabed. The primary subject is a diver in the foreground on the left, wearing a dark wetsuit, BCD, and fins, with a visible air tank. A second diver is visible in the background to the right. Bubbles are rising from the divers, indicating active breathing. The lighting is blue-tinted typical of underwater photography.

The foreground diver has a regulator hose leading to the mouth area. While the mouthpiece itself is small, the assembly is visually present and correctly positioned.
The resolution and lighting conditions make it impossible to definitively verify the clarity of the lens or see the eyes behind it. It is occluded by reflections and distance.
